mapper.select: SELECT ufd.id, ufd.file_id, ufd.nature_content_status, ufd.optimize_content_status, ufd.has_diagnosis_report, ufd.user_id, ufd.tenant_id, ufd.create_date, ufd.update_date, ufd.is_deleted, ufd.nat_set_time, ufd.opt_set_time, ufd.nat_set_job, ufd.opt_set_job, ufd.nature_source_type, ufd.optimize_source_type FROM tb_upload_file_detail AS ufd LEFT JOIN tb_upload_file AS uf ON ufd.file_id = uf.file_id WHERE uf.analysis_status = 2 AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND ufd.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (ufd.nature_content_status = 1 AND ufd.nat_set_job = 0 AND ufd.nature_source_type = 0) OR (ufd.optimize_content_status = 1 AND ufd.opt_set_job = 0 AND ufd.optimize_source_type = 0) ) ORDER BY ufd.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
